facts.raw_span: A man in his 60s presented with an enlarging purpuric patch on his left lateral superior forehead and left anterior scalp
initially present for 2 weeks
the lesion first developed in March 2014 and was fairly stable until June 2014
rapid growth and extension followed by central ulceration and bleeding
a 30 × 25-cm centrally eroded purpuric plaque with multifocal peripheral reddish-purple patches, papules, and macules
involving: Left anterior scalp with extension posteriorly on left parietal scalp
No evidence of lymphadenopathy in preauricular, cervical, occipital, submandibular or supraclavicular areas
Dermis permeated by irregular, slitlike spaces containing erythrocytes and lined by plump oval cells
Cells had pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and hyperchromatic nuclei
Cells stained positively with CD31 and were negative for CK5
No evidence of nodal, pulmonary, or liver metastases
Staging: T2N0M0

concepts.why: The presence of a large, centrally eroded purpuric plaque with multifocal peripheral reddish-purple patches, papules, and macules, along with the histopathological findings of irregular, slitlike spaces containing erythrocytes and lined by plump oval cells, suggests Angiosarcoma.

The clinical presentation of a purpuric patch with rapid growth and extension, along with the histopathological findings of slitlike spaces and plump oval cells, could be consistent with Kaposi's Sarcoma.

The presence of a large, purpuric plaque with multifocal peripheral reddish-purple patches, papules, and macules, along with the histopathological findings of irregular, slitlike spaces, could suggest Hemangioma.
The staging of T2N0M0 and the presence of irregular, slitlike spaces containing erythrocytes and lined by plump oval cells in the dermis may indicate Angioendotheliomatosis.

rationales.F01: Purpuric patch presentation is more typical of angiosarcoma than other options
rationales.F04: Rapid growth and ulceration are concerning features for angiosarcoma
rationales.F05: Large, centrally eroded purpuric plaque is highly suggestive of angiosarcoma
rationales.F08: Irregular slitlike spaces with erythrocytes are characteristic of angiosarcoma
rationales.F10: CD31 positivity is a strong indicator of vascular tumors like angiosarcoma
